questions.stem_text:
Mulholland (1998) argued that privatization changed the relationship between companies and
managers in that:

options.A: flexibility was reduced by the introduction of detailed daily worksheets
options.B: the state had greater control than managers over production processes
options.C: ownership was transferred from small shareholders to senior managers
options.D: employment depended on performance rather than trust and commitment

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - employment depended on performance rather than trust and commitment

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - the media manipulate 'the masses' as vulnerable, passive consumers

questions.stem_text: Traditional working class identity was based around:

options.A: shared working conditions in the manufacturing industry
options.B: the class consciousness of members of the proletariat
options.C: local communities, extended kinship networks and shared leisure pursuits
options.D: collective aspirations to move into the middle class

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - local communities, extended kinship networks and shared leisure pursuits
